interface.position: int32 [B]; row b's own cached tokens; token t of row b sits at prefix_length + position[b] + t (< 128)
interface.key_cache/value_cache: float32 (9,B,6,S,64), 1<=S<=128; row b's own slots, slots >= position[b] masked but finite
interface.prefix_length: int32 [1]; valid prefix slots, 0 = no prefix (P=1 of zeros)
interface.prefix_key/prefix_value: float32 (9,1,6,P,64), 1<=P<=128; shared by every row; slots >= prefix_length are masked but must be finite
interface.logits: float32 [B,12288]; last new token, no softmax
interface.new_key/new_value: float32 (9,B,6,T,64); the caller appends them to row b's own cache (or, for a prompt call, uses them as the prefix)

interface.position: int32 [B]; row b's own cached tokens; token t of row b sits at prefix_length + position[b] + t (< 128)
interface.key_cache/value_cache: float32 (9,B,6,S,64), 1<=S<=128; row b's own slots, slots >= position[b] masked but finite
interface.prefix_length: int32 [1]; valid prefix slots, 0 = no prefix (P=1 of zeros)
interface.prefix_key/prefix_value: float32 (9,1,6,P,64), 1<=P<=128; shared by every row; slots >= prefix_length are masked but must be finite
interface.allowed: int32 [K], 1<=K<=1024; one id list for every row
interface.logsumexp: float32 [B]; over all 12,288 logits of the last new token
interface.new_key/new_value: float32 (9,B,6,T,64); the caller appends them to row b's own cache (or, for a prompt call, uses them as the prefix)

interface.input_ids: int32 [B,T]; token t of row b sits at prefix_length + t
interface.targets: int32 [B,T]; the token after input_ids[b,t]; right padding with any id
interface.prefix_length: int32 [1]; valid prefix slots, 0 = no prefix (P=1 of zeros)
interface.prefix_key/prefix_value: float32 (9,1,6,P,64), 1<=P<=128; shared by every row; slots >= prefix_length are masked but must be finite
interface.target_logprobs: float32 [B,T]; log P(targets[b,t] | prefix + row b through t), normalized over all 12,288 logits; ignore padded positions

kv_batch_v3.policy: Caller owns all buffers. The prompt's new_key/new_value become prefix_key/prefix_value; each row appends its own new_key/new_value to its own cache. Masked slots must hold finite values.
